inputs.expected_repository_root: The worktree identified by the GIT_DIR administrative directory's gitdir pointer, before the ordinary git rev-parse fallback.

tests_run: simulated shared-hook invocation with GIT_DIR and GIT_INDEX_FILE bound to the linked worktree (PASS: transcript discovered from linked worktree)
